name: invalid_counts_mismatch_8x8
description: 8x8 mask_rle with a truncated final run: counts sum to 61, but size[0]*size[1] = 64. Simulates a corrupt/truncated wire payload. decodeMaskRle must reject this, not return a short/zero-padded buffer.
expected_error: counts sum (61) does not match size[0]*size[1] (64)
